messages:
maria: Quick idea: introduce a 'quorumed' apply flow for sensitive runtime flags (routing/quota/cost). propose -> pending until N approvers or timeout.

kevin: API + console both create pending proposals?

maria: yes. POST /flags/:id/propose returns pending_id.

sam: defaults: quorum=2, timeout=30m for medium, 24h for critical. require_2fa optional.

lee: ops emergency approve allowed with audit note. also auto-cancel on timeout.

anya: Console UX: show Pending / Approvers / TTL countdown, delegate approval option.

maria: telemetry: emit config.pending.created/approved/timed_out/applied/rollback with metadata.

kevin: data model: pending_changes(id, flag_id, state, approvers[], created_at, expires_at, change_blob, previous_blob). endpoints: propose, approve, cancel.

sam: dashboards: pending count, avg approval latency, stuck > 24h. alerts when pending_count > SLO.

lee: rollout: apply with gradual increments; fuse on errors -> revert to previous_blob and emit config.rollback.

maria: testing plan: 2w staging on non-critical flags, canary for routing/quota, then org rollout.

kevin: I'll own backend + API. maria: console mocks. sam: telemetry. ops-bot: audit wiring. GH issue incoming.

ops-bot: Reminder: audit events go to config-audit with 90d retention.
